The stop-loss threshold set on the initial order. If the market price moves unfavorably and hits 
this level, a separate stop-loss order is created with a market execution to close the trade.

takeProfitPrice.description:
The take-profit threshold set on the initial order. If the market price moves favorably and reaches 
this level, a separate take-profit order is created with a market execution to close the trade.

triggerPrice.description:
The price at which a conditional stop-loss or take-profit order is triggered. This is returned 
as part of the secondary order that is created based on the stopLossPrice or takeProfitPrice 
defined in the initial order.
